decisionGuards.decision8: Decision 8: Relationship to ADR-12 — the appliance is a superset, and `remote-tenant` is one of its modes. The delivered EAP model (ADR-12, in *Signal Loom Spireless Token-Based Agent Identity Migration (2026-Q4)*, and `docs/EAP/`) puts the platform on a ControlPlane-operated hub and ships the customer only the nine `signalloom-warden` objects plus two **consumer** Secrets copied from the central cluster, keeping the issuers central. SLSI mints its own Cosign, Witness, Orbit and SPIRE roots, so the appliance **is** a hub. Rather than fork the product, the appliance ships the hub components **and** the `signalloom-warden-overlays/remote-tenant` overlay, selected at bootstrap by **`APPLIANCE_MODE=hub|attached`**: `hub` runs its own issuers and local ingest; `attached` renders the warden-only overlay and consumes central issuer credentials exactly as ADR-12 specifies.
decisionGuards.decision9: Decision 9: Release trust by digest pin plus bundle-time signing. Third-party platform images are pinned by immutable digest and signed at bundle time with the SLSI release key; no separate release signing pipeline is built. The release **private** key stays in the build environment, in OpenBao transit used via Cosign's `openbao://` KMS URI; the appliance ships only the public half.

recommendedTests.name: test_manifest_image_digests_immutable
recommendedTests.assertion: Assert every entry in MANIFEST.json images array contains a valid sha256: immutable digest, zero tag-only references, and valid Cosign signature under release public key

recommendedTests.name: test_toolchain_version_consistency
recommendedTests.assertion: Assert scripts/setup.sh and scripts/ci/install-ci-tools.sh pin identical versions of kind, kubectl, flux, and cosign without syntax drift

recommendedTests.name: test_offline_bootstrap_egress_abort
recommendedTests.assertion: Assert that any outbound network egress attempt during offline bootstrap mode aborts immediately with a non-zero exit code

recommendedTests.name: test_host_bind_permissions_strict
recommendedTests.assertion: Assert /opt/tenants/<id>/data/ has permissions 0700 with subdirectories owned by container UIDs (Postgres 70:70, OpenBao 100:1000, Zot 65532:65532) and /opt/tenants/<id>/.keys/ is mode 0600 owned by root
